_comment: Cloud database security rules, one entry per collection. Every collection is deny-all for clients: the mini game never touches the database directly; all access is through cloud functions, which run with admin rights and bypass these rules. Paste each value into the console (Database > collection > Permissions > Custom rules). See README 'Database security rules' for why each collection needs deny-all. Cloud STORAGE has its own deny-all rule in ../storage/rules.json.

_rationale.daily_seeds: holds the daily seed, the full sheet and the best lineup (the answer key); a client read would spoil the daily (spec C5)
_rationale.daily_seed_bank: future seeds and their 12-0 lineups; a client read would spoil every coming day
_rationale.runs: validated runs with lineups and the stored best; a client write would forge results and challenges
_rationale.daily_starts: the one anchored daily attempt per player; a client write would reset or fake an attempt
_rationale.daily_results: source of the boards and streaks (openid keyed); a client write would forge ranks
_rationale.group_members: openGId and openid pairs gate the group boards (personal data)
_rationale.challenges: challenge owner, record, lineup (withheld until answered) and the sheet; a client read leaks openids and lineups
_rationale.challenge_answers: one marker per answerer and challenge so answers are counted once; a client write would inflate counts
_rationale.daily_stats: score distribution behind the rarity text; a client write would skew every percentile
_rationale.events: analytics with openid; written only through the validated track function
_rationale.rate_limits: per-openid counters; a client write would reset its own limit
_rationale.player_stats: streaks, bests and anomaly flags (personal data)
_rationale.daily_progress: progressive round delivery and the frozen action prefix; a client read or write defeats anti-lookahead
_rationale.anomalies: observe-only abuse flags; must not be visible to the people being observed
_rationale.app_config: remote config (ads caps, subscribe template); functions expose only the safe subset via getDaily
